kind: Reproducible Owner-only synthetic local development source; no formal QA
script:
from __future__ import annotations
import copy, dataclasses, hashlib, json, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
from backend.app.domain.blueprints import (CONTENT_VERSION, FAMILIES, Blueprint,
    select_blueprint, content_schema, request_manifest, assemble_draft)
from backend.app.domain.generated import canonical, compile_level, GeneratedRules
from contracts.v2.build_generation_content import build

ROOT=Path.cwd()
PATHS=['backend/app/domain/blueprints.py','contracts/v2/build_generation_content.py','contracts/v2/generation-content.schema.json']
def hashes(): return {name: hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in PATHS}
before=hashes()
start=time.monotonic()
rows=[]
def synthetic(bp):
    n=len(bp.puzzles)
    if bp.family=='position_v1':
        params={'digits':['2','5','7','9'],'positions':[3,1,4,2]}
        if n>=3: params['devices']=['device_c','device_a','device_d','device_b']
    else:
        params={'code_symbols':['C','A','D','B'],'digit_map':dict(zip('ABCD','2579'))}
        if n>=3: params.update(sequence_symbols=['G','E','H','F'],device_map=dict(zip('EFGH',('device_a','device_b','device_c','device_d'))))
    if n>=5: params['extra_digits']=['8','6','1','0']
    if n>=6: params['extra_devices']=['device_b','device_d','device_a','device_c']
    return {'content_version':CONTENT_VERSION,'blueprint_id':bp.blueprint_id,
      'title':'校园回廊','story':'课后寻找失落的档案。',
      'rooms':{rid:{'name':'安静教室','description':'教室等待重新开放。'} for rid in bp.room_ids},
      'objects':{obj.object_id:{'name':'校园物件','description':'与今日值班记录有关。'} for obj in bp.objects},
      'parameters':params}
def compile_replay(bp, content):
    draft=assemble_draft(bp,json.dumps(content,ensure_ascii=False))
    elapsed=time.monotonic()
    compiled=compile_level(draft,bp.room_count,bp.difficulty)
    rules=GeneratedRules(compiled)
    state=rules.initial_state()
    for action in compiled.witness: state,_=rules.apply_action(state,action['tool'],action['arguments'])
    assert state.status=='won' and state.room_id=='EXIT'
    assert all(len(room['objects'])<=8 for room in draft['rooms'])
    assert len(draft['puzzles'])==min(6,bp.room_count+{'easy':1,'normal':2,'hard':3}[bp.difficulty])
    return compiled, {'blueprint_id':bp.blueprint_id,'family':bp.family,'room_count':bp.room_count,'difficulty':bp.difficulty,
      'object_counts':[len(room['objects']) for room in draft['rooms']],
      'puzzle_count':len(draft['puzzles']),'clue_count':len(draft['clues']),
      'mechanisms':[p['mechanism'] for p in draft['puzzles']],
      'definition_hash':compiled.definition_hash,'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(canonical(content).encode()).hexdigest(),
      'witness_sha256':hashlib.sha256(canonical(compiled.witness).encode()).hexdigest(),
      'witness_actions':len(compiled.witness),'replayed_terminal':'EXIT/won','seconds':round(time.monotonic()-elapsed,6)}
static=build()
Draft202012Validator.check_schema(static)
for seed,family in enumerate(FAMILIES):
    for room_count in (1,2,3):
        for difficulty in ('easy','normal','hard'):
            bp=select_blueprint(room_count,difficulty,seed=seed)
            content=synthetic(bp)
            assert bp.family==family
            Draft202012Validator.check_schema(content_schema(bp))
            Draft202012Validator(static).validate(content)
            compiled,row=compile_replay(bp,content)
            rows.append(row)
variations=[]
for seed,family in enumerate(FAMILIES):
    bp=select_blueprint(3,'hard',seed=seed)
    content=synthetic(bp)
    original=compile_level(assemble_draft(bp,content),3,'hard',prove=False)
    # Two separate model parameter sets change real answer data, not just prose.
    for kind in ('base_digit','extra_sequence'):
        changed=copy.deepcopy(content)
        if kind=='base_digit':
            if family=='position_v1': changed['parameters']['digits'][0]='3'
            else: changed['parameters']['digit_map']['A']='3'
        else:
            changed['parameters']['extra_devices']=['device_c','device_b','device_d','device_a']
        compiled,row=compile_replay(bp,changed)
        pid='puzzle_1' if kind=='base_digit' else 'puzzle_5'
        assert compiled.answers[pid]!=original.answers[pid]
        assert {key:value for key,value in compiled.answers.items() if key!=pid}=={key:value for key,value in original.answers.items() if key!=pid}
        row.update(kind=kind,target_puzzle_id=pid,before_answer=original.answers[pid],after_answer=compiled.answers[pid])
        variations.append(row)
bad=[]
bp=select_blueprint(3,'hard',seed=0)
base=synthetic(bp)
def rejected(name,value):
    try: assemble_draft(bp,value)
    except ValueError as error: bad.append({'case':name,'error':str(error)})
    else: raise AssertionError(name+' unexpectedly accepted')
for name, change in (
  ('float_position',lambda d:d['parameters']['positions'].__setitem__(0,3.0)),
  ('bool_position',lambda d:d['parameters']['positions'].__setitem__(0,True)),
  ('numeric_digit',lambda d:d['parameters']['digits'].__setitem__(0,2)),
  ('duplicate_position',lambda d:d['parameters'].__setitem__('positions',[1,1,3,4])),
  ('duplicate_device',lambda d:d['parameters'].__setitem__('devices',['device_a']*4)),
  ('unknown_parameter',lambda d:d['parameters'].__setitem__('answer','1234')),
  ('missing_object',lambda d:d['objects'].pop(next(iter(d['objects'])))),
  ('unsafe_text',lambda d:d.__setitem__('story','<script>bad</script>')),
):
    changed=copy.deepcopy(base); change(changed); rejected(name,changed)
rejected('duplicate_json_key','{"title":"A","title":"B"}')
rejected('nonfinite','{"a":NaN}')
rejected('oversize','x'*65537)
rejected('too_deep','['*34+'0'+']'*34)
mapped=select_blueprint(3,'hard',seed=1)
mapped_content=synthetic(mapped)
mapped_content['parameters']['device_map']['F']='device_a'
try: assemble_draft(mapped,mapped_content)
except ValueError as error: bad.append({'case':'mapping_duplicate_value','error':str(error)})
else: raise AssertionError('mapping duplicate accepted')
try: bp.difficulty='easy'
except dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError: pass
else: raise AssertionError('mutable Blueprint')
schema=content_schema(bp); schema['properties']['title']['maxLength']=1
assert content_schema(bp)['properties']['title']['maxLength']==40
manifest=request_manifest(bp); manifest['object_slots'].clear()
assert request_manifest(bp)['object_slots']
after=hashes(); assert before==after
report={
 'kind':'Owner synthetic local development checks, not independent QA or real generation',
 'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'command':"C:\\Users\\liyh\\.conda\\envs\\1\\python.exe -c \"import json; exec(json.load(open('evidence/upgrade/v5.0/blueprint-generation/backend-check-plan.json',encoding='utf-8'))['script'])\"",
 'exit_code':0,'source_sha256_before':before,'source_sha256_after':after,
 'normal_compile_and_witness_replay_count':len(rows),'normal_cases':rows,
 'controlled_parameter_replays':variations,'negative_development_checks':bad,
 'immutability_and_fresh_schema_manifest':True,'static_schema_variant_count':len(static['oneOf']),
 'elapsed_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,6),
 'paid_calls':0,'network':0,'databases_opened':0,'provider_or_credentials_read':False,
 'limitations':['Synthetic values only; no actual AI reliability, theme fit or human gameplay quality claim.',
 'No API/Store/save/build/browser suite run in Owner checks; independent QA awaits stable Main freeze.',
 'Four mechanisms available across families; smaller puzzle counts intentionally use a subset.',
 'Additional typed source slots are independent; model-selected values can coincidentally yield the same answer.']
}
target=ROOT/'evidence/upgrade/v5.0/blueprint-generation/backend-development.json'
if target.exists(): raise RuntimeError('Refusing to overwrite development evidence')
target.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'normal_replays':len(rows),'parameter_variation_replays':len(variations),'negative_checks':len(bad),'seconds':report['elapsed_seconds'],'result':str(target)},ensure_ascii=False))
